LESSON: CREATION OF PLANTS AND ANIMALS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Family learner should be able to: family of your nuclear family? Creation 6 less
Topic 1.3: Creation of Plants and Animals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Creation of Plants and Animals. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention some plants and ● Learners to be taken on a nature walk to 6 lessons part of the environment
2. care for plants and animals as part of God’s creation.
3. appreciate plants and animals as part of God’s creation Core-Competences to be developed: Learning to learn; learners will develop the desire to explore and discover more about plants and animals in the surrounding, imagination and creativity; modelling and drawing animals and plants, communication and collaboration; nature walk

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. mention some plants and ● Learners to be taken on a nature walk to 6 lessons part of the environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to mention some plants and ● Learners to be taken on a nature walk to 6 lessons part of the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. care for plants and animals as part of God’s creation.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to care for plants and animals as part of God’s creation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate plants and animals as part of God’s creation Core-Competences to be developed: Learning to learn; learners will develop the desire to explore and discover more about plants and animals in the surrounding, imagination and creativity; modelling and drawing animals and plants, communication and collaboration; nature walk
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate plants and animals as part of God’s creation Core-Competences to be developed: Learning to learn; learners will develop the desire to explore and discover more about plants and animals in the surrounding, imagination and creativity; modelling and drawing animals and plants, communication and collaboration; nature walk. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Creation of Plants and Animals.
2. Explain Creation of Plants and Animals to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Creation of Plants and Animals.
4. Show that you can: mention some plants and ● Learners to be taken on a nature walk to 6 lessons part of the environment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Creation of Plants and Animals. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Creation of Plants and Animals important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. mention some plants and ● Learners to be taken on a nature walk to 6 lessons part of the environment
2. care for plants and animals as part of God’s creation.
3. appreciate plants and animals as part of God’s creation Core-Competences to be developed: Learning to learn; learners will develop the desire to explore and discover more about plants and animals in the surrounding, imagination and creativity; modelling and drawing animals and plants, communication and collaboration; nature walk

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
